description:
Navigate to the 'Roman Numerals' activity in GCompris (found under Math > Numeration). Play the activity and solve at least 5 conversion problems (Arabic to Roman or Roman to Arabic). Then, create a text file at '~/Documents/roman_guide.txt' to serve as a study cheat sheet. 

The file must contain:
1. A header line: 'Roman Numeral Reference'
2. A list of the 7 standard symbols and their values (I=1, V=5, X=10, L=50, C=100, D=500, M=1000). format doesn't matter as long as symbol and value are on the same line.
3. A brief sentence describing what the activity asked you to do (e.g., 'The game asked me to convert numbers...').
